title: Increase idle limit for user sessions
body:
Users are logged out after 5 minutes of inactivity.

## Review checklist
- [ ] Tests pass

Link to Devin run: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/abc
diff:
diff --git a/auth/session.py b/auth/session.py
--- a/auth/session.py
+++ b/auth/session.py
@@ -10,3 +10,3 @@
-IDLE_TIMEOUT = 300
+IDLE_TIMEOUT = 3600  # one hour
